        dp[i][i][0] = max(dist, dist + T)  # actually: give at dist, coin at dist+T, we pick at max(dist, dist+T) = dist+T if we wait there.

import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    N = int(next(it))
    E = int(next(it))
    T = int(next(it))
    xs = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(N)]

    # Split bears by side and sort by distance from 0.
    left = sorted([-x for x in xs if x < 0])   # store positive distances
    right = sorted([x for x in xs if x > 0])

    has_zero = any(x == 0 for x in xs)
    z = 1 if has_zero else 0

    L = len(left)
    R = len(right)

    INF = 10**30

    # dpL[i][j]: minimum time after giving candies to first i left bears and first j right bears,
    # and currently being at left position -left[i-1].
    # dpR[i][j]: same, but currently at right position right[j-1].
    dpL = [[INF] * (R + 1) for _ in range(L + 1)]
    dpR = [[INF] * (R + 1) for _ in range(L + 1)]

    # Start at 0. Giving candy to bear at 0 costs no movement/time, so it is already handled by z,
    # but it does not affect movement DP.
    if L == 0 and R == 0:
        # Only possible bear is at 0 or no bears at all.
        # Need to wait for coin at 0 if exists, then go to exit.
        ans = abs(E)
        if z:
            ans = max(ans, T) + abs(E) - 0  # incorrect form avoided below
            ans = T + abs(E)
        print(ans)
        return

    if L > 0:
        dpL[1][0] = left[0]
    if R > 0:
        dpR[0][1] = right[0]

    for i in range(L + 1):
        for j in range(R + 1):
            if i == 0 and j == 0:
                continue

            if i > 0:
                cur = dpL[i][j]
                if cur < INF:
                    if i < L:
                        # move further left
                        nxt = cur + (left[i] - left[i - 1])
                        if nxt < dpL[i + 1][j]:
                            dpL[i + 1][j] = nxt
                    if j < R:
                        # cross to right
                        nxt = cur + left[i - 1] + right[j]
                        if nxt < dpR[i][j + 1]:
                            dpR[i][j + 1] = nxt

            if j > 0:
                cur = dpR[i][j]
                if cur < INF:
                    if j < R:
                        # move further right
                        nxt = cur + (right[j] - right[j - 1])
                        if nxt < dpR[i][j + 1]:
                            dpR[i][j + 1] = nxt
                    if i < L:
                        # cross to left
                        nxt = cur + right[j - 1] + left[i]
                        if nxt < dpL[i + 1][j]:
                            dpL[i + 1][j] = nxt

    # After all candies are given, suppose the last given bear is at position p at time t_last.
    # Then all coins are collectible after time max(t_last + T, max_distance),
    # because by then every coin has appeared, and the farthest bear position has already been visited.
    # From that time, we only need to go from p to exit.
    max_dist = 0
    if L:
        max_dist = max(max_dist, left[-1])
    if R:
        max_dist = max(max_dist, right[-1])

    ans = INF

    if L == 0 and R == 0:
        base_ready = T if z else 0
        ans = base_ready + abs(E)
    else:
        if L > 0:
            t_last = dpL[L][R]
            p = -left[-1]
            finish_ready = max(t_last + T, max_dist, T if z else 0)
            ans = min(ans, finish_ready + abs(E - p))
        if R > 0:
            t_last = dpR[L][R]
            p = right[-1]
            finish_ready = max(t_last + T, max_dist, T if z else 0)
            ans = min(ans, finish_ready + abs(E - p))

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
